Class Holding

java.lang.Object
com.exchange.model.Holding
public class Holding extends Object
Represents an open position in an individual equity instrument within an investment portfolio.
Since:
1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • Holding

      public Holding(String symbol, int initialQuantity, double purchasePrice)
      Constructs a new Holding with an initial lot of shares.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the equity ticker identifier
      initialQuantity - the starting number of shares purchased
      purchasePrice - the execution price per share

  • Method Details

    • addShares

      public void addShares(int addedQuantity, double unitPrice)
      Incorporates an additional acquisition of shares into this position, recalculating the weighted-average cost basis.
      Parameters:
      addedQuantity - the number of newly purchased shares
      unitPrice - the execution price paid per newly acquired share

    • removeShares

      public double removeShares(int sharesToSell, double executionPrice)
      Liquidates a specified quantity of shares from this holding and calculates the realized gain or loss on the sold lot.
      Parameters:
      sharesToSell - the number of shares to liquidate
      executionPrice - the market price at which shares are sold
      Returns:
      the net realized profit or loss generated by this transaction

    • getMarketValue

      public double getMarketValue(double currentMarketPrice)
      Calculates the total current market value of this position given the prevailing spot price.
      Parameters:
      currentMarketPrice - the live price per share from the market
      Returns:
      the total gross valuation of the holding

    • getTotalCost

      public double getTotalCost()
      Calculates the total cost invested into this position (book value).
      Returns:
      the total book value invested in this holding

    • getUnrealizedProfitLoss

      public double getUnrealizedProfitLoss(double currentMarketPrice)
      Calculates the total unrealized (paper) profit or loss for this position.
      Parameters:
      currentMarketPrice - the live spot price of the stock
      Returns:
      the unrealized gain (positive) or loss (negative)

    • getUnrealizedRoiPercent

      public double getUnrealizedRoiPercent(double currentMarketPrice)
      Calculates the unrealized return on investment (ROI) percentage.
      Parameters:
      currentMarketPrice - the live spot price of the stock
      Returns:
      the return percentage relative to the cost basis
